title: G40 PROBE (throwaway): lane-shell confinement, read-only
goal: Run the G40 read-only probe from a real Builder lane's own shell and post the output as evidence (cgroup, mounts, uid, the socket checks). One task only.
context:
G40 PROBE (throwaway, one task, read-only). Purpose: find out whether a fleet lane's own shell is confined (case C) or can reach the owner's sockets (case W). This order exists ONLY for that probe: Nox ruled it (2 Nov 23:05Z PA-7 / L4-4, and the go of 2 Nov 18:08 ET). It must carry exactly ONE task and nothing else.

LEAD: decompose into exactly ONE task for a Builder with this goal: "Write the following seven read-only lines into a file g40.sh in your lane workspace, run it with bash from your own shell, save its complete output to g40-output.txt followed by a final line G40-END, commit both files with git (git add -A && git commit) and pass the commit sha to task_submit_built, and evidence_post the full output text. Run nothing else. Do not edit, create or delete anything outside the lane workspace. No network."
The seven lines:
  id -u
  cat /proc/self/cgroup
  grep -E ' /run | /home ' /proc/self/mountinfo
  test -w ~/.config/systemd/user ; echo "systemd-user-dir-writable=$?"
  test -S /run/user/1000/wayland-1 ; echo "wayland-socket=$?"
  test -S /run/user/1000/fleet/control.sock ; echo "control-socket=$?"
  ls /run/user
The task's done-when is a RUBRIC with exactly these five criteria (copy them verbatim into the task):
  1. g40-output.txt exists in the lane workspace, is committed with git, and ends with the line G40-END
  2. g40-output.txt shows the lane's OWN cgroup (the output of cat /proc/self/cgroup, a path line) and the uid (id -u)
  3. g40-output.txt shows the /run and /home mount lines from /proc/self/mountinfo (or states that grep found none)
  4. g40-output.txt shows the four probe results as exit codes: systemd-user-dir-writable, wayland-socket, control-socket, and the ls /run/user listing (or its error)
  5. the commands run were exactly the seven read-only lines of the order's context; no write outside the lane workspace, no network, nothing else was run
Do not add tasks, do not create orders, do not change this order's caps. The output is read by Lane 6 (Team E), who observes the run, and by a fresh Checker. Reading the result: all three tests true means case W (a lane can reach the owner's sockets), failures mean case C; the cgroup line says whether the shell sits inside the fleet unit.
constraints: read-only probe: no write outside the lane workspace
no spend beyond the lane's own model calls
anti_goals: no installs, no unit or config changes
do not run anything that is not one of the seven lines

done_when.text: mechanical close only: the evidence is the lane's posted output, observed by Lane 6 and rubric-checked by a fresh Checker at the task level

example: g40-output.txt with the cgroup path, the /run and /home mount lines, the uid, the three exit codes and the ls listing, ending with G40-END
evidence_required: the full text of g40-output.txt posted with evidence_post
the commit sha of the lane workspace commit
stop_conditions: the output is posted and the task is checked
any command in the probe errors in a way that needs a write outside the workspace: stop and report
ambition: settle case W or case C for the four legs
